lesson: In a risk‑off market, avoid buying on earnings even if the data is positive unless intraday momentum (m15 > 0.5%) and rvol > 1.5 are confirmed.
Only enter a long when the price is above VWAP and shows a clear breakout with strong volume; avoid buying near the stop or in low‑volatility conditions.
Tighten stop placement (e.g., 1–1.5% below entry) to reduce whipsaw losses in choppy markets.
Confirm a clear uptrend (price above VWAP and positive momentum) before buying news catalysts;
Use an ATR‑based stop (≥2% of ATR) instead of a fixed dollar stop to avoid premature stop‑outs on volatile moves;
Hold a position until it recovers above VWAP for at least 15 minutes before exiting on a VWAP dip.
